description.en: Send files and text between phones and computers on the same Wi-Fi. Open the page on each device (or scan its QR code); devices see each other at once, and every transfer waits for the receiver to accept.
description.zh: 在同一个 Wi-Fi 里的手机和电脑之间互传文件和文字。每台设备打开这个页面（或扫二维码），就能互相看到；每次发送都要对方点"接收"。

online.en: Opening the page from outside the local network goes through the Space's domain
online.zh: 在局域网外打开页面要经过 Space 的域名
